transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Our current contract expires next quarter. We need flexibility given market uncertainty, but also want the best pricing possible.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The discount is attractive. What about early termination if we get acquired or need to restructure?
